docs.summary: Marks a tool that is always available, including with an empty selection - which is what lets a tool build geometry from nothing. Always-available does not mean always-acting: a tool that should only do something when the user asks keeps its own enabled flag and draws a toggle in [`OnToolStripGUI`](#api~Prowl.Editor.GUI.SceneView.SceneTool~OnToolStripGUI).
Optional group label for the tool strip.
